headline: Domyn opens a staged 4B model release with training artifacts
summary: Domyn began releasing Edge, a 4B-parameter model, in stages. The first bundle includes base and supervised-fine-tuned checkpoints, intermediate training checkpoints, an 8.44-trillion-token stage-one pretraining mix, training scripts and supporting tools; the base model is listed under Apache 2.0 on its model card. Domyn says Edge was trained from scratch on 13 trillion tokens using the Leonardo system at CINECA. Remaining stage datasets, teacher models and post-training data, evaluation tooling and the final post-trained model are still listed as forthcoming. The release makes parts of the training process inspectable; it does not by itself validate the company’s performance claims or prove that the pipeline is independently reproducible.
